out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink next to the dish machine being used to store towels. Observed the handsink next to the 3 compartment sink being used to store 2 cast iron pans
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. MANAGEMENT MOVED THE ITEMS FROM THE HANDSINK BASINS. HANDSINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: 1) observed 3 containers of moldy blackberries
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. PIC DISCARDED THE BERRIES

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 3DRP prep top, Raw protein cooler: Raw salmon (60f), Raw steak (54f). Upon discussion with management, all Raw proteins are kept in the 2DR upright, Raw protein cooler overnight. Raw proteins were moved to the prep top 1 hour prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. MANAGEMENT MOVED ALL RAW PROTEINS FROM THE PREP TOP COOLER TO THE UPRIGHT COOLER TO CHILL TO 41f. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO STORE RAW PROTEINS IN THE UPRIGHT UNTIL THE PREP TOP COOLER IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: Food stored in a wet or soiled location as follows: 1) observed two containers of strawberries siting in a pool of cooler condensation in the 1DR prep top, charcuterie cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location. MANAGEMENT DISCARDED THE STRAWBERRIES.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter attached to the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC ORDERED AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE DURING THE INSPECTION. INSTALL ONCE THE DEVICE ARRIVES.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps in the ceiling tiles around pipes, conduits, and ventilation throughout the kitchen, primarily around the back door and water heater room
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. FILL ALL GAPS AND HOLES TO PREVENT ACCESS POINTS FOR PESTS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed multiple containers of compound butter, curry sauce, tempura batter, salad, and dressings being stored longer than its date marked label throughout the kitchen coolers.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE EXPIRED FOOD.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed multiple staff members not washing hands before putting on gloves to prepare food.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRAIN STAFF ON PROPER HANDWASHING TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION. SEE WHEN TO WASH FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the bar handsink and the handsink by the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PUT PAPER TOWELS AT BOTH HANDSINKS.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed a bleach bottle and soap bottle in the handsink by the 3 compartment sink. Observed a busboy container full of dishes on top of the handsink by the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED EVERYTHING OUT OF THE HANDSINKS. HANDSINKS NEED TO ACCESSIBLE AT ALL TIMES. PLEASE TRAIN STAFF TO NOT PUT THINGS IN HANDSINKS. MELTING POT (Inspection Date: 03/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no handwashing signage at the bar handsink and the handsink by the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS GAVE PIC HANDWASHING SIGNS TO POST BY BOTH SINKS.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine AT THE BAR was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. PIC CALLED OWNERSHIP TO HAVE A TECHNICIAN SERVICE THE BAR DISH MACHINE. DISCONTINUE USE UNTIL THE DISH MACHINE IS OPERATING PROPERLY. SERVICE TECHNICIAN WILL ARRIVE TODAY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed the 2DR upright by the back door handsink leaking.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC STATES THAT OWNERSHIP IS AWARE OF THE LEAK INSIDE THE UNIT. PLEASE FIX THE LEAK OR REPLACE THE UNIT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: Observed food debris under microwaves, prep tables, pre tops, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT MORE FREQUENT THOROUGH CLEANING IS REQUIRED.
